How to comment on a planning application in Tadley

Anyone can have their say on a planning application in Tadley. Find the application on the Basingstoke and Deane planning authority's public-access portal using the reference number above, then submit a comment before the consultation deadline. Comments are usually limited to planning matters such as overlooking, loss of light, traffic, noise and the character of the area.

Basingstoke and Deane is the local planning authority responsible for deciding applications in Tadley. Town Crier mirrors the public record so you can keep track of what is happening near you, but the council remains the authoritative source and the place to submit formal comments.
